messages:
marta: Heads-up: Support is seeing a bunch of SCIM failures and some SAML login errors for a handful of customers since ~02:10 UTC. Error pattern: audience mismatch / invalid_aud and SCIM 403s. Anyone tracking infra changes?

devin: Can you paste an assertion snippet or error? audience mismatch usually means SP entityID changed or metadata cached/stale.

marta: sample SP error from SAML proxy: `AuthnRequest rejected: Invalid audience: expected urn:redwood:sp:prod got urn:redwood:sp:prod-v2`

kim-support: customer says they rotated their SP metadata yesterday to add a new ACS but we didn't pick it up. They reported failing SCIM provisioning too.

henry-sec: if SP entityID diverged we would see audience problems. But why SCIM 403s? Are provisioning requests authenticated via the same IdP token? Maybe metadata cache served an older JWKS or removed key.

linda-ops: we deployed a metadata CDN cache invalidation change at 02:05 (job id: metadata-cache-ttl-reduce). Aim was to reduce origin load but the invalidate step had a bug and served a cached /saml/metadata.xml with old entityID for ~20m. Rolling back now.

deploy-bot: rollback started: revert-metadata-cache-invalidate -> 1830010022

devin: that explains audience. For SCIM 403s, check the IdP JWKS and signing cert used by the SP. If the SP rotated keys and IdP uses cached metadata it might be rejecting signatures. Run: `curl -s https://idp.prod.example.com/.well-known/openid-configuration` and `curl -s https://idp.prod.example.com/jwks.json | jq '.keys[].kid'`

marta: running jwks check now  jwks shows two keys but one has `x5c` that looks expired according to openssl decode. Also KMS rotation happened ~03:00 UTC for signing alias `redwood-idp-signing`. Linda, did we run any KMS ops?

linda-ops: we triggered a scheduled KMS rotation job (rotate-signing-2026-07-12) at 02:58 which rotated a secondary key to be primary. That job updated the signing alias and pushed new cert bundle to secret manager. I did not touch metadata cache. But if CDN served stale metadata earlier it could have missed the updated key publishing.

henry-sec: two risks: (1) metadata cache served old entityID causing SAML audience errors; (2) key publish race: secret manager updated but metadata/jwks endpoint still served pre-rotation key until origin refresh. That means some SPs saw invalid signatures or missing key -> SCIM 403. Need to reconcile origin -> CDN timeline and KMS writes.

devin: mitigation: 1) roll back metadata cache change (in progress), 2) ensure jwks endpoint reflects the active key (invalidate CDN for /jwks.json), 3) temporarily accept previous key for 5m grace window in the validation library if possible. We should also pause any automated RBAC mass-changes until identity steady.

marta: paused RBAC bulk job: rb-rollback-check flagged and job paused.

linda-ops: invalidated CDN for /saml/metadata.xml and /jwks.json and restarted the metadata sync worker. Deploy-bot: cdn-invalidate -> 1830010056

deploy-bot: cdn-invalidate completed -> 1830010068

marta: after invalidate, SAML requests show correct entityID and jwks now includes both `prod-v1` and `prod-v2` kids. SCIM provisioning retries are succeeding for most accounts.

henry-sec: follow-ups: (a) add a preflight in KMS rotation to call metadata endpoints and verify keys present, (b) add a CDN invalidation step as part of the rotation workflow (atomic update + invalidate), (c) add an alert when `/saml/metadata.xml` entityID != expected value for prod, (d) add canary tests exercising SSO and SCIM post-rotation.

devin: also consider a short-lived relaxed audience check during rotation windows (accept a list of known entityIDs for N minutes) but only if signed and audited. That reduces fanout failure risk.

audit-bot: created alert-rule: metadata-entityid-mismatch -> pager (owner=eng-security)

linda-ops: action items Ill do: revert cache TTL change, add atomic CDN invalidate step to rotation job, and add a post-rotation smoke test that hits SSO + SCIM endpoints. Pausing automated RBAC rollouts during identity infra changes.

marta: Ill draft a short incident summary and create a postmortem template with timeline, root cause (CDN cache + KMS rotation race), and remediation. Marking as sev3.

henry-sec: please include evidence from KMS audit and CDN logs in the PM. Also add a note to training docs about sequencing identity rotations.

marta: will do. Closing thread after PM published. Thanks all :thumbsup:
